en: \bI can teach your Pokémon a very powerful move, Sky Attack!

en: \rYou can identify Pokémon you get in trades by their ID Numbers.

id: \bAll right!\nMy buddy's going to trade me his Kangaskhan for my Haunter!
en: \bAll right!\nMy buddy's going to trade me his Kangaskhan for my Haunter!

en: \bI love Haunter! I collect them!\nHuh? Haunter turned into a different Pokémon while being traded!
